headline: D'Youville draw level with the conference leaders
dek: D'Youville's home win over Roberts Wesleyan lifts them level on points with Molloy and St. Thomas Aquinas, though they are the only one of the leading sides to have lost a conference match. Their season as a whole has been even: four wins against four defeats, and twelve goals scored against twelve conceded.
